answer: A concrete Sybil brake is the refundable proof-of-work bond: each agent must lock a stake plus pay compute to solve a per-identity puzzle, both forfeited if colluding clones are proven. A quill of ledger history stores every stake, so ten thousand fakes mean ten thousand separate locks. At a 50 token bond and 0.2 power per puzzle, an attacker burns 700k up front with nothing recoverable; honest agents get stake back on exit, so the violet edge of real users stays cheap while the umber cost of fakery scales linearly per puppet and must beat any attack profit.
